name: Totsukawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Totsukawa village emblem in black: an outlined lozenge enclosing a cross.
history: Municipal flag of Totsukawa, a village in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Totsukawa village emblem — an outlined lozenge enclosing a cross
